workstreams.title: Fix pagination bug in the reports API
workstreams.body: The reports endpoint returns duplicate rows when a client asks for the second page. The cursor is built from the created timestamp alone, so two rows written in the same second land on both pages.

workstreams.title: Add dark mode to the settings page
workstreams.body: Every screen honours the colour scheme except the settings page, which still hard-codes its panel and border colours. ## Approach

workstreams.title: Replace the legacy CSV importer
workstreams.body: The importer reads the whole file into memory and splits on commas, so a quoted field holding a comma breaks the row. Large uploads also exhaust the worker. ## Approach

workstreams.title: Cut cold-start time on the search worker
workstreams.body: A cold search worker takes about nine seconds to answer its first query. The synonym dictionary is loaded and parsed on every start. ## Approach

workstreams.title: Rotate the expiring signing keys
workstreams.body: The token signing keys expire at the end of the quarter. Rotation needs an overlap window so tokens signed with the old key still verify while clients pick up the new one. ## Blocked by

workstreams.title: Add rate limiting to the public API
workstreams.body: The public endpoints had no limit, so a single misconfigured client could saturate the request pool. ## Outcome

workstreams.title: Ship the audit log export
workstreams.body: Administrators needed a way to export the audit log for a date range without a database query. ## Outcome

workstreams.title: Migrate the mailer to the new template engine
workstreams.body: The plan was to move every transactional message to the newer template engine for shared layouts and inline previews. ## Why this was dropped
